analysis.summaryJa: becauseは聞き手が求める理由を明確に焦点化し、asとsinceは既知または自然に共有できる理由を背景として添える。会話ではBecause節だけでWhyへの直接回答ができ、That's becauseは直前の結果を受けて原因を説明する。in thatは「〜という点で」を表し、文語的なforは独立節の後から理由を補う。
grammarPoints: becauseによる明確な原因提示とWhyへの直接回答
asとsinceによる軽い・共有済みの背景理由
That's becauseによる直前の結果の原因説明
in thatによる評価の根拠となる側面の限定
forによる文語的・後置的な理由の補足
visualEvidence: 赤いSTRONG LINKの橋がbecauseの強い原因焦点を示している
青いSOFT LINKの橋がasとsinceの背景的な理由を示している
会話カードがBecauseだけの直接返答とThat’s becauseの説明導入を対比している
例文表がbecause・as・since・in that・forの役割を色分けしている
commonTraps: Whyへの直接回答でasやsinceだけを使う
That's becauseの後に原因ではなく結果を置く
in thatを単なるbecauseと同じ意味で無差別に使う
文語的forを文頭の従属接続詞として使う

questions.prompt: The client renewed the service contract ------- our support team resolved every issue promptly.

choices.A: although
choices.B: unless
choices.C: because
choices.D: until

questions.explanationJa: 契約更新の具体的な原因を明確に示すためbecauseが唯一適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- all department heads have approved the proposal, we can send it to the director today.

choices.A: Since
choices.B: Unless
choices.C: While
choices.D: Even though

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly explains a preceding result.

choices.B: Our electricity bill fell this month. That’s because of we installed efficient lighting.
choices.C: Our electricity bill fell this month because. That’s we installed efficient lighting.
choices.D: Because our electricity bill fell this month. That’s why efficient lighting installed.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the clearest cause-and-effect relationship.

choices.B: The shipment was returned until the address label was incomplete.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses literary “for” correctly.

choices.C: The security guard remained at the entrance, for the last guest had not yet left.
choices.D: The security guard for remained at the entrance because the last guest.

choices.C: As the venue limited parking, visitors are encouraged using the shuttle.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly distinguishes a result from its cause.

choices.B: Sales increased in June. Because that’s the referral campaign launched in May.
choices.C: That’s because sales increased in June, so the company had launched a campaign in May.

questions.translationJa: 6月に売上が増えました。それは会社が5月に紹介キャンペーンを開始したからです。
questions.explanationJa: 増加という結果の後で、その原因をThat’s because節が説明しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence in which the reason connector is grammatically complete.

choices.A: Because of the maintenance team found a leak, the pool will remain closed today.
choices.B: Because finding the maintenance team a leak, the pool will remain closed today.
choices.C: Because the maintenance team found a leak, the pool will remain closed today.

choices.C: Since everyone receiving the revised schedule yesterday, we will not distribute another copy.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The store closed early because there were no customers.”

choices.B: The store closed early so that no customers could enter.
choices.C: Although customers were present, the store closed early.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Since all seats are reserved, registration is now closed.”

choices.B: Seats were reserved in order to close the registration desk.
choices.C: Registration is closed even though many seats remain available.
choices.D: Registration is now closed because every seat has already been reserved.

questions.translationJa: すべての席がすでに予約済みなので、現在は登録を締め切っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The plan is practical in that it requires no additional staff.”

choices.B: The plan requires no staff because it is not practical.
choices.C: One practical aspect of the plan is that it needs no extra employees.
choices.D: Additional staff members consider the plan practical.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The lobby is crowded. That’s because two conferences are being held today.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We left the office early because the roads were becoming icy.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager stayed, for several customers still needed assistance.”

choices.C: The manager left although customers requested assistance.
choices.D: Customers no longer needed help, so the manager remained.

questions.translationJa: 何人かの顧客がまだ支援を必要としていたため、管理者は残りました。
questions.explanationJa: 理由を後置するforは、この文ではbecauseと同じ因果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Because the invoice was incorrect, payment was delayed.”

choices.B: Payment was postponed as a result of an error on the invoice.
choices.C: Payment was made promptly despite an invoice error.
choices.D: The payment delay caused the invoice to be accurate.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Since you have already completed the safety course, you may enter the laboratory.”
